data.content_ref: inline:Close the loop from suspension to edge synthesis: when the boundary atlas shows a stable suspension pattern across two genuinely different school families, auto-register a probe warrant that attacks the suspended cluster from an exogenous anchor — the LAMBDA_FLOOR role the spec calls load-bearing, not decorative. Because the new edge is a registered warrant with normal carriage rules, it faces the same scrutiny and can itself be attacked; per-run determinism and polynomial cost are preserved because the fixpoint runs on the new edge set exactly as before, and committed-root validity holds since new edges only ever attack, never invent acceptance. Counterexample: auto-generated warrants can be spurious, so synthesis must be gated on cross-family stability and the generated warrant must carry provenance back to the atlas that triggered it.
